instruction: I have a folder called "meeting_notes_Feb" on the desktop. Please rename it to "meeting_notes_March".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'meeting_notes_Feb' to 'meeting_notes_March'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation changes the directory name pattern while maintaining the same task complexity.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH conditions: (1) new directory 'meeting_notes_March' exists AND (2) old directory 'meeting_notes_Feb' no longer exists
Uses proper shell logic with '&&' operators to ensure both conditions must be true for success
Expected value 'Renamed successfully.\n' correctly matches the success message from the command
Prevents false positives: cannot pass by simply creating a new directory without removing the old one
Complete coverage: fully verifies the rename operation as specified in the instruction
Metric 'exact_match' is appropriate for this binary pass/fail verification
